summary: Kerb where cars park, backing onto a lawn, but apartments sit 12-15 m off.

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks 15 m or more on the kerb side; parkland and trees across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parking lane where cars are stopped; room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Short street linking to a busy arterial at the top; moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along the kerb, so a van blends in; only a weekday evening no-stopping sign nearby.

flags: Evening no-stopping sign on Sir Fred Schonell Drive 4-6:30pm Mon-Fri
Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, Toowong Creek 309 m away
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from both sides; sun mostly blocked.

best_section.where: Douglas Street west kerb, beside the lawn south of the apartment car park
